rateLimits.note: Above 1,000 calls a second a site key needs reCAPTCHA Enterprise or an approved exception (FAQ).
"Site keys are considered over quota if more than 1,000,000 calls per month are used for any domain" (FAQ); counted per key here, the stricter form of per domain.

attribution.text: This site is protected by reCAPTCHA.

provenance.notes: Limits from the FAQ for keys of the classic API (siteverify). Pricing (docs.cloud.google.com/recaptcha/docs/compare-tiers, 2026-11-10): Essentials free up to 10,000 assessments a calendar month per organization (all its accounts and sites together); Premium free to 10,000, then USD 8 flat for 10,001-100,000 and USD 1 per 1,000 above, with a billing account; Enterprise a fixed monthly commitment at USD 1 per 1,000. Those are prices, not limits: not declared as rate limits, a site on Essentials may declare 10,000 a month as its own tightening. The badge may be hidden only if the reCAPTCHA branding stays visible in the user flow, with the text "This site is protected by reCAPTCHA.": attribution declared required. Caching, storage and redistribution not addressed.
